profile.headline: Web Developer at Cornerstone Services Inc.
profile.summary: I'm a web developer in the Chicagoland area with a diverse educational background.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Created a comprehensive content management system (CMS) for the "Cultural Connections" committee, enabling users to upload, manage, and curate articles and images for display on the company's intranet.

Designed and developed an innovative applicant tracking system (ATS) tailored to streamline hiring operations.

Implemented a user-friendly interface with advanced search and filtering functionalities and served as a
centralized communication hub, logging all interactions between HR and applicants. Integration of the
SimpleTexting API allowed HR personnel to seamlessly engage with applicants via text messages sent directly
from the web application, resulting in improved candidate engagement and timely follow-ups.

Adapted swiftly to evolving legal requirements in the non-profit healthcare industry, proactively updating web tools for compliance and data security while mitigating potential risks.

Maintained a client-focused approach, fostering frequent interactions with colleagues to gather feedback,
understand pain points, and drive iterative enhancement of web tools to align with their evolving needs.

Delivered prompt and effective resolution of IT Help Desk requests, correcting bugs and thoroughly documenting problem-solving steps and interactions within the IT Help Desk system.
